The current Account source is active but has no separate aggregationMode rule requiring an Account-specific edit. Later related aggregation issues FHIR-26386 and FHIR-39644 are already represented on the combined branch and do not remove the FHIR-14402 populated-reference requirement.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The active ElementDefinition page still states that if aggregationMode is present, Reference.reference must be present and have a value and the reference target must be aggregated as defined; the datatype spreadsheet still links aggregation and versioning comments to that rule.
